messages.aboutText: Vulman is an all-in-one vulnerability management local desktop application for your coding projects and infrastructure. It is highly secure and uses AES-GCM encryption to keep vulnerability results in a local database. Vulman never stores your code or infrastructure data in its database or data directory, and it never passes any of it to any 3rd party. Only vulnerability detection and code-scanning results are kept in the Vulman local database using AES-GCM encryption, and the encryption key is stored in the Vulman local data directory as vulman.key.
messages.aboutArchitecture: Vulman is written in Go and JavaScript with an embedded, encrypted bbolt database. It uses Go Wails architecture to build the native UI. Because of the architecture, Vulman is very lightweight and relatively fast.
messages.aboutGiftMessage: If you can find a security hole in Vulman that lets Vulman record and maliciously send local data to a 3rd party, I will buy you a coffee. Please get in touch with us through Vulman's public repository to get the coffee bill:

messages.cacheScopeHint: These limits and freshness settings apply only to API responses. Local vulnerability databases have separate storage and update schedules.
messages.clearAPIResponseCacheConfirm: Clear all cached API responses? Your projects, findings, credentials, activity history, and downloaded CVE, NVD/CPE, and OSV databases will be kept. Active and future API requests may fill the cache again.
messages.apiCacheClearHint: Clears stored API responses only. API requests may fill the cache again; the database file may retain freed disk space.
messages.error_api_cache_clear_failed: Could not clear the API response cache.
messages.assessmentActionHint: Match registered tech stack components against vulnerability databases (VDBs). Full-project assessments also run configured code scanners when code scanning is enabled for the project. Component-only assessments and reassessment from local data skip code scanning.
messages.componentMatchHint: Match this component against enabled vulnerability databases. Repository code scanners do not run for component-only assessments.
messages.repositoryScanHint: Scan only the selected registered repository with configured code scanners. Other repository and tech stack findings are preserved. Repository scans require code scanning to be enabled for the project and use normal assessment mode.
messages.error_repository_scan_scope_invalid: Select either a component or a repository. Repository scans use normal assessment mode.
messages.error_scan_repository_not_registered: The selected repository is no longer registered in this project.
